Supreme Court Orders ECI to Decide TMC Name and Symbol Dispute

The Supreme Court has directed the Election Commission of India (ECI) to decide on the dispute concerning the Trinamool Congress (TMC) party's name and election symbol within three to four months. The dispute involves two opposing factions within the TMC vying for control of the party's name and its 'flower and grass' symbol. The court's directive mandates the ECI to resolve this matter promptly.
